header: Six mentors for people changing careers
lead: Aubruck runs the district's mentoring scheme for people retraining as surveyors. Sessions are free, last one hour on a Wednesday afternoon, and you do not need to apply to us.
note: Sessions run from October to June. Mentors without a button are fully booked this term. Try again after the spring intake.
